tools.name: list_virtech_products
tools.description: Elenca i prodotti pubblicati da Virtech, opzionalmente filtrati per stato.

tools.name: get_virtech_product
tools.description: Trova il prodotto attraverso il suo identificativo esatto, per esempio tracciamy.

tools.name: get_virtech_contact
tools.description: Restituisce l'indirizzo della pagina Contattaci e l'email pubblica di Virtech.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_virtech_contact · Private data: get_virtech_contact · Public sink: get_virtech_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_virtech_contact · Private data: get_virtech_contact · Public sink: get_virtech_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
